risk_assessment.risk_factor: RBA fourth rate hike triggering housing correction
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce REIT and developer exposure; increase cash/gold allocation; monitor RBA statement for forward guidance
Avoid speculative developer equities; favour established builders; monitor construction sector credit spreads

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Geopolitical escalation (Iran, Venezuela) disrupting oil/AI supply chains
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge with energy and gold; diversify away from single-region tech exposure
Reduce QAN.AX exposure; monitor Qantas Group (QAN.AX) and related logistics names

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Tasmanian power station fire causing energy supply disruption
risk_assessment.mitigation: Monitor AGL.AX, CGP.AX for supply-contract repricing; assess insurance implications

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Productivity decline and per capita recession eroding corporate earnings
risk_assessment.mitigation: Favour dividend-paying defensives (WES.AX, WOW.AX, CSL.AX); avoid growth-at-any-price names

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight gold miners on inflation hedge and WA discovery pipeline
opportunities.rationale: Multiple high-grade discoveries (Gateway, King River 44g/t, Auric $28M profit) plus Iran-driven safe-haven demand; gold as inflation hedge against home-grown price pressures

opportunities.recommendation: Add coal-exposed names on Chinese demand and energy transition lag
opportunities.rationale: Coal boom returns as Chinese solar only just passes coal; thermal demand persists; Tas fire adds supply tightness

opportunities.recommendation: Position in defensive consumer staples ahead of rate hike
opportunities.rationale: Mortgage stress and housing correction shift consumer spending to essentials; WES/WOW offer dividend yield and defensive beta

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce REIT and property developer exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: 10% house price downside, 18-year high mortgage stress, Bathla default risk, and looming rate hike create severe downside for property-linked equities

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim Qantas and transport exposure ahead of potential strike
defensive_moves.rationale: Ground crew strike vote creates operational and earnings risk; industrial action could cascade

defensive_moves.recommendation: Increase cash and short-duration bond allocation
defensive_moves.rationale: Rate hike uncertainty and equity volatility favour liquidity; bond yields spiking offers carry

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to remain under pressure in 1–3 month window. Rate hike fears, housing correction, and developer defaults dominate. Gold and coal provide relative strength. Qantas strike and Tas energy disruption add volatility. Expect ^AXJO to trade in a range with downside bias unless RBA signals pause.
market_outlook.long_term: 6–12 month outlook cautious. Productivity 'bad to worse' and per capita recession cap earnings growth. Housing correction may deepen. However, gold discovery pipeline, energy transition, and potential RBA pivot if economy weakens further offer recovery catalysts. Structural shift toward defensives and resources.
